## Resolvable interface

Anything that hydrates into a result.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface Resolvable<Result>
```

## Remarks

The broadest view: generic consumers (sync, output, forwarding to an agent) can accept any `Resolvable` without inspecting form or cardinality, and still receive a typed result.
